verdict.rationale: The Virginia State Corporation Commission is a state government registry and filing authority. Records filed there are held by the Commonwealth by definition, so letting a filer choose a storage region or residency is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, which say nothing about data residency, so no item is cited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
